name: XlPasteSpecialOperation
description: Specifies how numeric data will be calculated with the destinations cells on the worksheet.

constants.name: xlPasteSpecialOperationAdd
constants.description: Copied data will be added to the value in the destination cell.

constants.name: xlPasteSpecialOperationDivide
constants.description: Copied data will divide the value in the destination cell.

constants.name: xlPasteSpecialOperationMultiply
constants.description: Copied data will multiply the value in the destination cell.

constants.name: xlPasteSpecialOperationNone
constants.description: No calculation will be done in the paste operation.

constants.name: xlPasteSpecialOperationSubtract
constants.description: Copied data will be subtracted from the value in the destination cell.
